scope: One original-native fitted-plane duplicate and separate application GUI/public-MCP duplicate on the same PLY file; not full M4 acceptance.

native.operation: Plane(1) history menu Duplicate created Plane(1)(1) and Planes(2).
native.beforeSave: Original and duplicate showed the same displayed normal and offset in Type In mode.
native.reopen: Both history items reopened; the duplicate editor retained those displayed values.
native.cleanup: Authenticated owned finish, zero active processes, closed handles, no cleanup errors, released mutex; 100.06 seconds under 540-second outer lease.

storedReadback.scope: Strict, data-only index and bounded field comparison of the two pinned QSF v4 files; no native execution or reference-point/line copy-policy claim.
storedReadback.observation: The four original record spans are byte-identical after duplication; a fifth type-0x8 record is appended. The two type-0x8 records contain the observed Plane(1) and Plane(1)(1) strings and each repeats a different 16-byte value in two positions. Excluding those two 16-byte fields and string count/value leaves 304 compared bytes, with one differing byte at normalized offset 4. Its four-byte little-endian values are 4 and 5, matching these records' one-based positions; that field's meaning and source/dependent links are not established.
storedReadback.initialOffsetAttempt: A first exploratory read used the point/line name offset and returned empty strings; that interpretation was rejected and its receipt retained. The corrected bounded read uses the next field and matches the independently observed native names.

applicationAndMcp.coverage: Actual GUI menu Duplicate and public stdio MCP object_duplicate produced distinct identities and equal fit/frame to the original and each other; GUI undo and MCP-created copy project-worker reopen and undo passed.
applicationAndMcp.cleanup: Private ephemeral ports closed, owned processes exited and mutex released; 23.28 seconds under 480-second outer lease.

limitations: The same input file does not establish matching native and application fit populations, weighting, residuals or frame conventions; no fit equivalence is claimed.
Native displayed decimals are not raw binary values. No source edits or dependency identity were tested; original plane properties were not reread after reopen.
The native case concerns a fitted plane, not semantic reference point or line duplication. Native undo, locks, transforms and other modes remain open.
This checkpoint does not complete M4 or authorize merge or milestone closure.
